cap-java/cds-feature-auditlog-ng.name: cds-feature-auditlog-ng
cap-java/cds-feature-auditlog-ng.description: Emit standardized audit log events from Java CAP applications with the Audit Log Service NG Java CAP plugin.  The plugin ensures compatibility with the Audit Log Event Catalog, aligning emitted events with shared semantic conventions for consistency across systems.
cap-java/cds-feature-auditlog-ng.readme_excerpt: The CDS plugin for SAP Audit Log service enables Java CAP applications to emit audit log events in a standardized way. It is fully compatible with the Audit Log Event Catalog, ensuring standardized event semantics and compatibility. You can emit the following types of audit log events: - Personal Data Access Event - Personal Data Modification Event - Configuration Change Event - Security Event Official CAP documentation can be found here. For both local and cloud testing, refer to the cloud-cap-samples-java repository and follow the instructions provided in its README. For local testing, make sure to create a default-env.json file
readme_headings: CDS plugin for SAP Audit Log service

cap-java/cds-feature-data-inspector.name: cds-feature-data-inspector
cap-java/cds-feature-data-inspector.description: A CDS plugin designed to help support users and developers securely inspect raw database content in both local and production environments, ensuring compliance with security standards. It supports multiple data sources—including database entities and services—providing direct, auditable access for troubleshooting and analysis.
cap-java/cds-feature-data-inspector.readme_excerpt: `cds-feature-data-inspector` is a plugin to **view data** of CAP Java applications. This plugin focuses on the CAP Java runtime: it provides the Data Inspector OData **service definition and handler implementations**. The SAPUI5 app and the `cds add data-inspector` command are provided by the Node.js `@cap-js/data-inspector` plugin. A CAP Java consumer therefore gets the full experience by combining the two: - This CAP Java plugin (added as a Maven dependency) for the runtime - `@cap-js/data-inspector` (as a **devDependency**) for the UI using `cds build` and the project wiring using `cds add`. For more information, see Setup for SAP BTP and Accessing
readme_headings: SAP Cloud Application Programming Model Data Inspector Plugin for Java

cap-java/cds-feature-notifications.description: A CAP Java plugin that integrates SAP Alert Notification service (ANS) with the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) for sending business notifications.
cap-java/cds-feature-notifications.readme_excerpt: A CAP Java plugin that integrates SAP Alert Notification service (ANS) with the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) for sending business notifications. The `cds-feature-notifications` plugin enables out-of-the-box notification handling for CAP Java applications. Annotate CDS events with `@notification`, emit them from a handler or annotate entities with `@notifications` for automatic delivery triggered by CRUD events, actions, or functions. The plugin takes care of the rest and delivers notifications via SAP Alert Notification service (ANS). In **local mode**, notifications are logged to the console with no ANS binding required. In **production mode**, notifications are delivered through Web (SAP Build Work

cap-java/incidents-app.name: incidents-app
cap-java/incidents-app.readme_excerpt: Welcome to the Incident Management reference sample application for CAP and development recommendations provided by the SAP BTP Developer Guide. The application support team members to create and process incidents on behalf of registered customers. The basic domain model is depicted below. Assumed you prepared for CAP development as documented in capire's *Getting Started > Jumpstart* page, ... Clone the repository and install dependencies: git clone https://github.com/cap-java/incidents-app cd incidents-app mvn clean compile Run the application locally: cd srv mvn cds:watch Then open http://localhost:8080/ . You can see all the default services and UI endpoints listed in the CAP default landing
